findings.location: Paragraph: "The killdeer also has no qualms..." (source.html third paragraph after figure)
findings.source_quote: The killdeer also has no qualms with expressing rash disfavor to those who intrude their domain, but these are not to be mistaken as songs.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the French rendition that uses an uncommon or misspelled species name with the standard French name or a faithful transliteration. For example: change “Le pluvier kildir” to “Le pluvier kildir (killdeer)” or simply “le killdeer (pluvier kildir)” depending on house style. Preserve surrounding HTML tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Le pluvier kildir ne craint pas non plus d'exprimer un vif mécontentement envers ceux qui envahissent son domaine, mais ceux-ci ne doivent pas être confondus avec des chants.

findings.location: Paragraph: "The canary sings in a cage..." (source.html paragraph describing different birds' songs)
findings.source_quote: The canary sings in a cage, while the nightingale sings in the dark.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the gender/article and noun to standard French: change “La canari chante” to “Le canari chante” (or “Le canari chante en cage, tandis que le rossignol chante dans l'obscurité.”). Keep original HTML tags intact.
findings.translation_quote: La canari chante en cage, tandis que le rossignol chante dans l'obscurité.

findings.location: Paragraph: "As diverse as their song may be..." (same paragraph as above)
findings.source_quote: The buntings fill in the heat of the day when other birds are silent.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or provide the recognized French name for “buntings” instead of leaving the English plural. For example: change “Les buntings remplissent” to “Les bruants (buntings) remplissent” or simply “Les bruants remplissent”. Preserve HTML tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Les buntings remplissent la chaleur du jour quand les autres oiseaux se taisent.

findings.location: Paragraph: "Neglect. The cowbird is also black..." (source.html starting 'Neglect' paragraph)
findings.source_quote: The cowbird is also black (the female is brown/gray). She will be found sitting on a high vantage...
findings.suggested_fix: Use the correct common French name and gender for the species. Replace “La vacherie est aussi noire (la femelle est brune/grise).” with e.g. “Le vacher à tête (cowbird) est aussi noir (la femelle est brune/grise).” or simply “Le vacher est aussi noir…”. Keep HTML structure unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: La vacherie est aussi noire (la femelle est brune/grise). On la trouvera perchée à un haut point de vue, appelant sans honte ses amants par son cri perçant.
